data.one_liner: Catch deferred deep links from Facebook ads using the FB App Links SDK.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that enables catching deferred deep links sent from Facebook after an app is installed via a Facebook ad. It interacts with the native Facebook SDK to retrieve deep link URLs and handle tracking.
use_when: You are running Facebook ad campaigns and need to handle deferred deep links upon first app launch
You need to route users to specific screens inside your app based on Facebook ad clicks
avoid_when: You only need standard deep linking without Facebook SDK integration
You cannot comply with Facebook's privacy and GDPR user consent requirements prior to SDK initialization
strengths: Direct integration with Facebook App Links SDK for Android and iOS
Provides explicit methods to initialize and fetch deferred deep links
weaknesses: Requires manual platform-specific configuration in Android Strings/Manifest and iOS Info.plist
Requires explicit user consent handling for GDPR compliance before calling initialization methods
data.setup_notes: Requires adding Facebook App ID and Client Token to Android's strings.xml and AndroidManifest.xml, and configuring URL schemes and keys in iOS Info.plist.
